title: Additive Dispenser Changes
lead: MOC has made some changes to the ATF Onboard Additive Dispenser for better performance. The user will now need to press and hold down both buttons at the same time to dispense the attached additive.
body: Remove the tube assembly from the existing 90° push connect fitting, then unscrew the fitting from the bulkhead adapter. Assemble the 4 new parts, clamping the tube assembly that was removed from the push connect fitting to the 98090 Hose Barb.
